name: Licensing-readiness and compliance file for private kindergartens and children's mini-centres (licensing from 2027, unannounced inspections from Feb 2026)
buyer: Owners of about 6,500 private kindergartens and related child-service operators (mini-centres, children's camps)
trigger: Mandatory licensing of all kindergartens reported from 1 Jan 2027 (phased, readiness-based; Education Ministry). Requirements include buildings, staff qualifications, programmes, material base, sanitary and fire norms, anti-terror protection and conditions for special-needs children. Since 1 Feb 2026 a control procedure allows unannounced inspections of organisations serving children.
evidence: https://tengrinews.kz/tengri-institutions/novyie-pravila-chto-jdt-chastnyie-detsadyi-v-kazahstane-594367/amp/ (fetched: 11,909 preschool organisations, 6,526 private, 96% hold the state order); https://informburo.kz/novosti/vladelcy-castnyx-detsadov-v-kazaxstane-poprosili-edinyx-pravil-licenzirovaniia (owners ask for a single list of requirements and a transition period); https://www.zakon.kz/stati/6515172-zachem-vvodyat-litsenzirovanie-detsadov-v-kazakhstane-i-kak-poluchit-razreshenie-na-rabotu.html
existing: Competitor search 'программа для частного детского сада Казахстан учет посещаемости лицензирование' found no licensing-prep product. It showed only the state Indigo voucher system (12 regions) and the model operating rules for preschools.
unchecked: Name and number of the law and licence rules; whether the licence is issued through eLicense; list of required documents; penalties; whether the date is final (sources vary between next year and 1 Jan 2027); number of mini-centres; existing kindergarten software such as electronic registers.

first_check.duty: Licensing became mandatory for all preschool organisations, state and private, from 1 Jan 2027. The source is the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 30 Dec 2024 on state awards, education and child-rights protection. It amends the Law on Permits and Notifications (Annex 1, non-transferable class 1 licence) and Article 57 of the Law on Education. Qualification requirements and supporting documents are set by Order No. 268 of 27 Nov 2025 (justice registration No. 37500), which amends Order No. 473 of 24 Nov 2022. It adds item 8 with points 73-82 and annex forms, in force from 1 Jan 2027, and points 79 and 81 were revised from 12 Jul 2026. The requirements cover curricula and development cards, at least 75% permanent staff and at least 20% with teaching categories, teaching materials, a medical room plus a medical licence or contract (exempt up to 3 groups), a sanitary conclusion for the kitchen, premises owned or leased for at least 5 years with sanitary and fire acts, equipment and anti-terror protection (Order No. 117), an edu.kz domain, NOBD data entry, special-needs conditions, and 36 hours of training at least every 3 years. Processing takes up to 30 working days. A lawyer told zakon.kz (10 Jun 2026) there is no transitional period and no early filing, because notification rules apply until then. Kindergartens without a licence lose the state order. A specific Administrative Code fine for kindergartens was not confirmed; schools were fined under Article 463. Separately, unannounced inspections of organisations serving children have been allowed since 1 Feb 2026 (Tengri). The claim says licensing is "phased, readiness-based"; that is the Ministry's wording, and the lawyer disputes it. Whether applications go through eLicense was not verified; egov says eLicense split education licence services by level in Feb 2025.
first_check.market: The Ministry of Education counts 11,909 preschool organisations, of which 6,526 are private (Tengri, Apr 2026); another source gives about 11,872 and 6,300+. Kindergartens employ about 99,330 staff (NOBD, via zakon.kz). No figure was found for mini-centres. Children's camps and health centres fall under a separate licence that is already on eLicense.
first_check.competitor: No licensing-readiness software or kindergarten-specific "turnkey licence" provider turned up in Russian-language searches. Adjacent products: the state NOBD and ED24 systems (attendance and data), the Indigo voucher system, the BALAM parent app (health, menu, schedule), and 1C:General Education Institution. None of these prepares the licence file or checks the qualification requirements. General licensing consultants probably exist but were not found by name.
first_check.reason: The duty is real and in force. A law of 30 Dec 2024 amending the Law on Permits and Notifications (Annex 1, class 1 licence) and Article 57 of the Law on Education makes preschool education a licensed activity from 1 Jan 2027. Order No. 268 of 27 Nov 2025 adds items 73-82 to Order No. 473, listing requirements and the forms to file in Annexes 1-8 (staff, premises, sanitary and fire, anti-terror, NOBD data, inclusion, 36 hours of training every 3 years). A lawyer says there is no transitional period and applications open only on 1 Jan, so about 12,000 kindergartens may apply at once. Six searches found no licensing-prep software or named done-for-you provider. Weaknesses: the licence is mostly a one-off, today's date leaves under 3 months, budgets are thin, and penalties for kindergartens were not confirmed.

challenge_check.killer: None found. The closest risks are that the job is a one-off licence, that state-order compliance already covers most requirements, and that the deadline is very close (1 Jan 2027).
challenge_check.reason: No product or named consultant does this job; the duty is real and firm. A zakon.kz lawyer piece (10 Jun 2026) says licensing starts 1 Jan 2027 with no transition period. Until then only notification applies, so all ~12,000 kindergartens may apply at once. The Almaty akimat counts 896 private kindergartens in the city alone. Weaknesses: the duty is mostly one-off. Unlike the 5-year licence for children's camps, a recurring kindergarten licence is unverified. 96% of private kindergartens already meet similar state-order rules (CCTV, alarm button, fire and sanitary norms). Applications go through the free state licensing service. With about 12 weeks to the deadline, the build-and-sell window is tight. Inspection-readiness after licensing could make it recurring.
